original_annotations.instruction: On Wikipedia, open the article for the specific seed used to coat the dough in the video and verify whether it is recognized as a major food allergen in the United States.

observed_events.description: The wearer portions dough, works near the bakery roller and arranges relatively short straight pieces in rows.

Rounded dough portions are fed through a guarded countertop machine and elongated pieces emerge at its front. The visible operation supports bread-dough moulding; the brand, exact model, internal roller count and manufacturer-specific settings are not established.
The wearer hand-rolls a later piece into a long thin strand, bends adjacent loops and presses them together. No end-through-loop knot is established.

visual_review.scope_limit: The continuous source and released frame at 25 seconds show the guarded machine, incoming portions and elongated output. Exact manufacturer, model, internal roller arrangement and safe operating settings are not inferred.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent refine a station-operation demonstration into a setup-and-operation guide when the colleague takes on preparation duties?
construct.belief_before: One video demonstrating how to use the observed guarded roller/belt dough-moulding equipment class; a manual shaping recipe alone does not meet the released machine-operation purpose.
construct.belief_after: One guide that actually teaches setup and dough handling for the class of guarded bread-dough moulding equipment shown. Exact brand is neither visible nor required.
construct.required_behavior_change: Check whether the selected machine-use demonstration also teaches setup and adjustments. Retain a complete guide; replace a demonstration that only shows feeding and output. Keep exactly one video.
construct.no_update_failure: Retain a feed-and-output demonstration whose published evidence does not teach setup and adjustments.
construct.overupdate_failure: Add a second guide instead of retaining exactly one complete resource.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The released scene supplies the guarded roller/belt moulding class. Both requests refer to that station without supplying its name, brand or controls. Manual methods no longer satisfy A. Setup is an authored future training need, not an alleged source action. Complete no_scene comparison remains an independent review requirement.

observed.why: The colleague takes on preparation duties as well as operating this station. The new need adds setup and adjustments; it adds no brand or inferred source action.

answer_boundary_review.unknown_policy: Evaluate description, chapters, native captions and public previews together. Missing captions alone never excludes a guide. The listed insufficient-public-evidence entities lack a deciding published setup/adjustment step; this does not claim that their full upstream films contain no teaching or their machines are physically unsuitable. Three clearly supported guides can complete B. Related is a similarity ring, not a physical rejection. Current A requires machine use, so the former generic manual initial answers do not carry over.

final_rejections.reason: Complete native captions 0:00–8:47 teach bowl/wooden-spoon mixing, hand stretch-and-fold and round-boule shaping, then Dutch-oven baking. They explicitly mention a stand mixer only as an optional mixing substitute, not setup/feeding of the guarded roller bread moulder. The lexical dough/handle overlap is not a complete operating guide.

Complete native captions 0:00–8:50 teach weighing flour and operating a bowl-and-spiral-hook mixer: fit the bowl and hook, close the safety cage, set ten minutes/speed one, and stop before changing gears (5:01–6:31). This is real equipment instruction, but for mixing ingredients in a bowl, not the visible continuous feed/roller moulding station. It remains a meaningful text-only equipment alternative, not a title-only recipe.

Complete native captions 0:00–12:11 teach hand kneading, the gluten window test, bulk fermentation and blanket-style folding, ending before division. No machine setup or feeding is taught in this complete sequence; its hand-handling instructions do not satisfy equipment-operation training.

Native creator description and complete chapter list identify Fevicryl Mouldit clay preparation, hand rolling, coils and leaves for Lippan wall art. The demonstrated material and craft process are not edible dough or bakery equipment operation.
Native creator description identifies weaving newspaper tubes into a basket for storing bread. This is not forming edible dough or operating the visible dough machine.

The complete creator recipe covers bowl/spoon mixing and five hand-shaped outcomes: boule, baguette, pizza, bagel and pretzel. Those manual steps met the superseded generic shaping purpose, not current A machine use. None of those published methods teaches adjustment or feeding of the guarded roller moulder needed for the new station-operation training purpose. The word Everything refers to the dough uses, not all bakery machines.

The complete four-recipe creator instructions teach rolling-pin sheets, hand-rolled cylinders/strands, twisting, cutting and icing. This was a legitimate superseded generic shaping lesson; it does not teach powered bakery-machine setup or feeding. Do not inherit the old pin-versus-palms exclusion.
